The '''1965–66 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 30th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 28 November 1965 and ended on 19 June 1966. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their 16th Greek title and their first in seven years.

The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
